summary: Tested announcements pagination end-to-end (backend + frontend + admin + editor). 10/10 backend pytest cases passed and all frontend flows work as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: fetch_announcements_page uses .to_list(limit) — passing limit as the length arg is fine, but it's a bit non-obvious; consider .to_list(length=limit) for clarity.

GET /api/announcements and /api/admin/announcements do not validate page/limit types (FastAPI coerces query strings, but negative values are silently clamped; consider returning 422 for invalid inputs for better API hygiene).
Admin panel deleteAnnouncement client logic (step back when last item on page) was not directly asserted here — worth a follow-up test once TEST notices are cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: None. Created + deleted one 'TEST_regression_admin_post' notice during admin flow (cleaned up via authenticated DELETE, status 204). One 'TEST_editor_pending_regress' pending-change was created via editor flow — this is a queued pending_change (not a published notice); main agent may want to reject/clean it up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pagination verified with 20-notice dataset. Once main agent deletes the 12 TEST_ notices, only 8 real notices remain and Pagination component intentionally renders nothing (pages<=1) — this is by design, not a bug. There is one leftover editor pending_change 'TEST_editor_pending_regress' from the editor regression test that may need cleanup via approvals tab.

backend.GET /api/announcements default: returns {items,total,page,pages,limit} with limit=10, page=1, 10 items, pinned notice first
backend.page=2 &limit=10: returns 10 items on page 2, no overlap with page 1

detailed_verifications.frontend_notices_page: Count line 'Showing 1–10 of 20 notices' → page 2 → 'Showing 11–20 of 20 notices' → Prev → back to 1–10. Pinned 'District Trials — All Age Groups' shown first with Pinned badge.
detailed_verifications.homepage: Renders 'View all notices' link and pinned 'District Trials' notice (adapted to new response shape).
detailed_verifications.admin_panel_admin_role: Stat card shows '20' (total, not page count). Announcements tab shows 'Page 1 of 2 · 20 notices' with pagination. Page 2 navigates correctly. Posting new notice reloads to page 1 and count becomes 'Page 1 of 3 · 21 notices', stat updates to 21.
detailed_verifications.editor_role: Login works, Announcements tab paginated ('Page 1 of 2 · 20 notices'). Posting creates a pending change ('Submitted — an admin must approve...') — does not increment published total.
